title.zh: U.S. CFTC  seeks event contract definitions that may defy states' gambling claims
title.en: U.S. CFTC  seeks event contract definitions that may defy states' gambling claims

current_state.zh: The U.S. CFTC submitted two rules to White House review that would define prediction-market event contracts as swaps and explicitly disconnect them from gambling, setting up a conflict with states and recent court rulings.
current_state.en: The U.S. CFTC submitted two rules to White House review that would define prediction-market event contracts as swaps and explicitly disconnect them from gambling, setting up a conflict with states and recent court rulings.
